profile.headline: Software Engineer II at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

positions.title: Student Fellow
positions.description: - Attended coaching and mentorship sessions with experienced technical professionals from finance and banking

positions.title: GCT Software Development Summer Analyst
positions.description:
- Increased four microservices code coverage using JUnit testing and Mockito
- Created a CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins to allow collaboration with potential partners and API integration with the Developers Portal

positions.title: Women's Leadership Camp
positions.description: Selected from a group of 3,000+ applicants to attend career workshops, network with professionals, and to develop leadership skills.

positions.title: Early ID Technology Program (Mentee)
positions.description:
Early ID Technology Program: Women’s Leadership Program
Track: Global Consumer Technology

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a peer-to-peer lending mobile application and integrated two Mastercard APIs and two Start Path portfolio company services
- Designed and implemented the app using React Native, NodeJs and Postman
- Responsible for coding the front-end and user experience of the product

positions.title: Software Engineering Summit
positions.description:
- Chosen as one of 40 students to attend Capital One’s Software Engineering Summit in Richmond, Virginia
- Attended numerous workshops such as Machine Learning, AWS, iOS, Android, Bots and APIs
- Developed a TrashBot in C++ that sorts trash, compost, and recycling materials using IBM’s Machine Learning models and an Arduino

positions.title: Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
- Normalized and performed data validation on 12 years of inconsistent data which allowed for improved analysis
- Generated reports in SAS imported by Excel spreadsheets
- Programmed various SAS procedures such as PROC REPORT and PROC SQL

company.name: The City University of New York

positions.title: Technology Strategic Intern
positions.description:
Technology for Social Good, Diversity & Inclusion
- Leveraged Agile methodology to design and build an in-house website to promote and register Youth Programs such as Girls who code, and All star code
- Conducted research and analysis on regional STEM trends and prepared report which identified new opportunities for curating contents/curriculum.
